cohort: The study included 6212 parturient women, categorized by history of bariatric surgery and BMI, from Qatar.
finding: Women in the post-Bariatric Surgery (BS) group were more likely to experience cesarean delivery, preterm birth, stillbirth, and low-birth-weight neonates compared to women in normal weight, overweight, and obesity BMI categories.
mod_finding: Women in the post-BS group were significantly more likely to have a cesarean delivery (37.5% vs. 24%, aOR = 1.59) compared to normal weight women.
